# Create New Programming Assignment

1. Gather the programming concept and difficulty from the teacher.
2. Create `assignments/<kebab-case-id>/README.md` from `templates/assignment-template.md`.
3. Register the assignment in `config.json` with an id, title, description, path, and due date.
4. Verify that the directory and configuration entry both exist.
